title: hierarchicalMenu "Show more" limit can make sub levels inaccessible
body: ### 🐛 Current behavior The hierarchicalMenu's "show more" button is shown/hidden based on whether the **first level** of facet values exceeds the limit. But the showMoreLimit is then **also applied to _lower levels_** of the menu, potentially hiding some facet values and making them inaccessible. ### 🔍 Steps to reproduce 1. Go to https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/hierarchical-menu-example-forked-mjtx54 2. Click "show more" 3. Search for "dishwasher" 4. Expand the "Appliances" menu item There are now 6 top-level facet values and 8 children underneath Appliances: 5. Click "show less" The limit parameter of 6 has now been applied, so only 6 children underneath Appliances are visible **BUT** the "show more" button is now greyed out - because the top level facet values (6) don't exceed the limit param (6). The extra children underneath Appliances are hidden and totally inaccessible now without clearing the search query and starting again. Worse if it's on something like an ecommerce category page which isn't using a search query at all - the children become permanently inaccessible. ### Live reproduction https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/hierarchical-menu-example-forked-mjtx54 ### 💭 Expected behavior Either: - The limit / showMore / showMoreLimit parameters should apply only to the top level of hierarchicalMenu values, or - The disabling of the "show more" button should take into account the number of values for lower depths of items (for the current refinement) ### Package version instantsearch.js@4.81.0 ### Operating system _No response_ ### Browser _No response_ ### Code of Conduct - [x] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct
